integrity: Analytic proof with reproducible symbolic and killed-generator checks. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Renewal proof assumes fresh independent attempts and an independent rate-r exponential interruption clock.
The uniformly distributed initial phase is essential; results concern the mean and not a pathwise stochastic order.
Equal marginal reset-location frequencies are unconditional by proposed reset index; survival-conditioned frequencies can differ.
Publication priority remains uncertain pending independent full literature audit.
title: Alternating the reset site strictly accelerates two-location Poisson search
